{{Infobox map |name=Locomoto Machine |year=2021 |image=Locomoto1.png |creator=[[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[QuakeR]] |gametype=4on4 |size=Large }} Locomoto Machine (locomoto.bsp) is a 4on4 Team Deathmatch map created by [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[QuakeR]]. Quaker made the map qwdm5 in 2018 and he reforged the map with a nice "blade runner" theme. There are 9 spawnpoints. ===Items=== {{MapItems |quad=1 |ring=1 |pent=1 |hp100=2 |ra=1 |ya=1 |ga=1 |lg=1 |rl=2 |gl=1 |sng=1 |ng= |ssg=1 }} ==Gallery== Locomoto2.png Locomoto3.png Locomoto4.png Locomoto5.png ==Layout== This map is real tight with a "big" space in the middle. To get quad you need to take the 2-way teleporter, rocketjump or trickjump. Pent is up high and Ring is hidden away from the fights. With 3 big guns on this map it should be a real mayhem. LG is here but only 1 small cell pack. RA is in the water and the water area also got a megahealth.

{{Col}} ==Strategy & Tactics== LG is always important and on this map it can really do damage, but with limited ammo maybe the 2 RLs are more important. The 2 RLs are rather close to each other and that could be exploited, though one of the paths need rocketjumping. On a tight map like this the armors will be most important as they are very effective even with ssg and sng.
